Writeup: Founder and Chief Curator, I devote every spare moment I can to YieldMore.org which began to take shape in June 2013. I believe we can make the world a better place (for you and for me and the entire human race) if we begin to genuinely take interest in the lives of the people around us and by giving the best of our learnings, time and ideas. Any person or organization that can be inspired to help themselves and their fellow beings live happier is dear to me.
